authority.fallback: When a derived leg is unavailable or rejected, render/interpolate the canonical straight stop-to-stop chord.

method: Canonical legacy patterns and stop order come only from routes.json.
Canonical StopNode positions come only from stops.json.
Source ida/vuelta MultiLineStrings are treated as presentation road-shape support, not route authority.
Each canonical stop is projected to the source-line network; consecutive canonical StopNodes are connected through a weighted source network.
Preferred source lines are cheaper than secondary source corridors; small source-network gaps may bridge only within a bounded tolerance.
Legs failing snap/detour/network-bridge quality checks fall back to the canonical straight chord.
notes: The source line catalogue is not a one-to-one naming match for the legacy A/A2/B/C/D-F/E/G/H network.
Source geometry is used only to improve visual road-following shape.
Road direction, road legality, and historical timetable semantics are not inferred from this file.
